from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyShareCapital(BaseModel):
    """Share capital information extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the report")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/securities code of the company")
    share_capital: float | None = Field(description="The share capital amount in yuan")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    section_location: str | None = Field(description="Where in the report this data appears, e.g. '合并资产负债表所有者权益部分'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyShareCapital]
